T: Three girls from Detroit, one spotlight, and the chicken comes out first.
D: In 1960s Detroit, three young singers are signed by an ambitious car salesman turned manager, and the climb to the top starts to pull them apart.
P: Serve the snacks when the Dreamettes step out on stage at the Detroit talent show.
S: the Detroit talent show where the Dreamettes first get noticed

Beef frankfurts in soft rolls under a fine, spiced beef chilli sauce with yellow mustard and chopped onion. Brown 300g beef mince with half a finely chopped onion, 1 crushed garlic clove and 1 tbsp oil, breaking it up very fine. Stir in 1 tbsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp sweet paprika and 2 tbsp tomato paste, then 250ml beef stock, and simmer for 20 minutes until thick. Season. Heat 8 beef frankfurts in barely simmering water for 5 minutes. Warm 8 long soft bread rolls, put a frankfurt in each, spoon over the chilli and finish with yellow mustard and the rest of the raw onion.
Effie's fried green tomatoes with hot sauce mayo
Effie, the voice nobody in the room can talk over

Thick slices of green tomato in a crunchy spiced polenta crust, fried golden, with hot sauce mayonnaise. Salt 4 green tomatoes cut in 1cm slices and leave for 10 minutes, then pat dry. Mix 125g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp hot sauce and 1 tsp lemon juice. Coat each slice in 100g plain flour, then 2 eggs whisked with 125ml buttermilk, then 120g fine polenta mixed with 1 tsp paprika and 1/2 tsp cayenne. Shallow fry in 250ml oil over medium high heat for about 3 minutes a side until golden. Drain, sprinkle with salt and serve hot with the mayo.
M: Rainbow Records Sunday fried chicken with baked mac and cheese
the new label's Sunday dinner the week the first record takes off

Buttermilk-soaked chicken in a crisp spiced coating, fried deep golden, with baked cheddar macaroni and a crunchy crumb top. Whisk 500ml buttermilk, 2 tbsp hot sauce and 1 tsp salt and turn 1.5kg chicken thighs and drumsticks through it. Marinate in the fridge for 4 hours. Boil 300g macaroni until just tender. Melt 40g butter, stir in 3 tbsp flour and whisk in 600ml milk until thick, then stir in most of 250g grated vintage cheddar and 1 tsp mustard powder and fold through the pasta. Top with the rest of the cheese and 50g breadcrumbs and bake at 180C for 25 minutes. Meanwhile heat 1.5 litres of oil to 165C. Mix 250g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp each garlic powder, cayenne and black pepper and 1 tsp salt. Press the chicken into the flour and fry in batches for 12 to 14 minutes until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack for 5 minutes and serve with the mac and cheese.
W: Lorrell, the youngest of the three, cracking jokes on the tour bus between shows

Silky spiced sweet potato custard in a crisp shortcrust case, with soft whipped cream. Boil 600g orange sweet potato until very soft, drain and mash until smooth. Line a 23cm pie dish with a sheet of shortcrust pastry and blind bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Whisk the sweet potato with 60g melted butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 160ml evaporated milk, 1 tsp vanilla, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp nutmeg and a pinch of salt. Pour into the case and bake for 45 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool for 1 hour and serve with 300ml cream whipped to soft peaks.
K: the Dreams in gold sequins on a glittering Las Vegas stage

A sugar cube soaked in aromatic bitters under chilled sparkling wine with a twist of orange. Drop a sugar cube into each of 4 chilled flutes and soak each with 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Top slowly with 600ml chilled sparkling wine, then twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the chilli up to 3 days ahead and reheat; warm the dogs and rolls to serve

steps.text: Brown the beef mince with half the onion, the garlic and the oil, breaking it up very fine with a wooden spoon.
Stir in the chilli powder, cumin, paprika and tomato paste, then the stock. Simmer, stirring, until thick and saucy, and season.
Heat the dogs in a pan of barely simmering water.
Warm the rolls, put a dog in each, spoon over the chilli and finish with a stripe of mustard and the rest of the onion.

veg.make_ahead: Make the chilli up to 3 days ahead and reheat; warm the dogs and rolls to serve

steps.text: Cook the mushrooms with half the onion, the garlic and the oil until dark, then add the lentils and mash them roughly.
Stir in the chilli powder, cumin, paprika and tomato paste, then the stock. Simmer, stirring, until thick and saucy, and season.
Heat the dogs in a pan of barely simmering water.
Warm the rolls, put a dog in each, spoon over the chilli and finish with a stripe of mustard and the rest of the onion.

dishes.n: Effie's fried green tomatoes with hot sauce mayo
dishes.make_ahead: Make the hot sauce mayo up to 3 days ahead; crumb the tomatoes up to 1 hour ahead and fry to serve

steps.text: Salt the tomato slices and leave on a rack for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Mix the mayonnaise, hot sauce and lemon juice.
Set out the flour, then the eggs whisked with the buttermilk, then the polenta mixed with the paprika and cayenne. Coat each slice in all three.
Shallow fry in the oil over medium high heat, in batches, for about 3 minutes a side until golden.
Drain on paper towel, sprinkle with salt and serve hot with the hot sauce mayo.

dishes.n: Rainbow Records Sunday fried chicken with baked mac and cheese
dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the chicken up to 1 day ahead; make the mac and cheese up to 1 day ahead and bake on the night

ingredients.item: chicken thighs and drumsticks, bone in

steps.text: Whisk the buttermilk, hot sauce and half the salt and turn the chicken through it.
Marinate in the fridge.
Boil the macaroni in salted water until just tender and drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the sauce flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Stir in most of the cheddar and the mustard powder and fold through the macaroni.
Heat the oven to 180C. Tip into a baking dish, top with the rest of the cheddar and the breadcrumbs and bake until golden and bubbling.
Meanwhile heat the oil in a deep heavy pot to 165C. Mix the coating flour with the paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, pepper and the rest of the salt.
Lift the chicken from the buttermilk, press firmly into the flour and fry in batches, turning, for 12 to 14 minutes until deep golden and cooked through.
Drain on a rack for 5 minutes and serve with the mac and cheese.

veg.n: Rainbow Records Sunday fried cauliflower with baked mac and cheese
veg.make_ahead: Marinate the cauliflower up to 4 hours ahead; make the mac and cheese up to 1 day ahead and bake on the night

steps.text: Whisk the buttermilk, hot sauce and half the salt and turn the cauliflower through it.
Marinate in the fridge.
Boil the macaroni in salted water until just tender and drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the sauce flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Stir in most of the cheddar and the mustard powder and fold through the macaroni.
Heat the oven to 180C. Tip into a baking dish, top with the rest of the cheddar and the breadcrumbs and bake until golden and bubbling.
Meanwhile heat the oil in a deep heavy pot to 165C. Mix the coating flour with the paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, pepper and the rest of the salt.
Lift the cauliflower from the buttermilk, press firmly into the flour and fry in batches, turning, for 6 to 8 minutes until deep golden and tender.
Drain on a rack for 5 minutes and serve with the mac and cheese.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake the pie up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; whip the cream to serve

ingredients.item: orange sweet potato, peeled and chunked

steps.text: Boil the sweet potato until very soft, drain well.
Mash until completely smooth and cool slightly.
Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23cm pie dish with the pastry, prick, line with baking paper and rice and blind bake, then remove the paper and rice.
Whisk the sweet potato with the butter, sugar, eggs, evaporated milk, vanilla, spices and salt.
Pour into the pastry case and bake until set at the edges with a slight wobble in the middle.
Cool to room temperature.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and serve with slices of the pie.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the sparkling wine and the flutes up to 1 day ahead; build each glass to order

steps.text: Drop a sugar cube into each flute and soak it with 2 dashes of bitters.
Top slowly with the sparkling wine.
Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.

af.make_ahead: Chill the alcohol-free sparkling wine and the flutes up to 1 day ahead; build each glass to order

steps.text: Drop a sugar cube into each flute and soak it with a few drops of vanilla.
Rub a strip of orange peel around the rim of each glass, then top slowly with the alcohol-free sparkling wine.
Twist the peel over each glass and drop it in.
